findings.title: Conditional passkeys are no longer initialized for an unselected user
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())` returns false whenever the username/password form is first displayed because no user has been resolved yet. Consequently `fillContextForm` is not called for normal initial login (or after a failed normal password attempt, where the user is cleared), so the page lacks the WebAuthn challenge and conditional-UI attributes required to offer/discover passkeys. Previously this was deliberately initialized whenever passkeys were realm-enabled, including before identity selection. This breaks passwordless/passkey login from the standard Username Password Form and also contradicts the existing tests that expect the `webauth` form on the initial page.
